in_sanskrit.name: Bavyesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Vishnu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bavyesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bavyesh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words: Ba (Lord) and Vyesh (Vishnu). This name is used to denote the Lord of Vishnu, who is an essential deity in Hinduism known for preserving the universe.
